review.tagline: Blank Python LangGraph scaffold with config, tests and Studio support
review.summary: The blank-slate LangGraph template: src/agent/graph.py holds a one-node graph that returns a fixed string and its runtime context, with langgraph.json, a .env.example and unit plus integration test workflows already in place. Start it with langgraph dev and open it in Studio; there is no model, no tools and no UI. For Python developers who want the LangGraph Platform layout without an opinionated agent.
review.audience: Python developers wanting the LangGraph Platform layout
strengths: Correct langgraph.json, package layout and CI from the first commit
No model dependency; add the provider you want
Unit and integration test workflows included
weaknesses: Does nothing until you add a model call and nodes
No chat UI; Studio or the API is the interface
Assumes LangGraph Server and Platform as the runtime
